WHAT: Gender-aware shoe size resolution — resolveVintedSizeId(size, gender) returns array
WHERE: lib/catalog-ids.ts — MEN_SHOE_SIZE_IDS map, WOMEN_SHOE_SIZE_IDS map
HOW:
  EU 44 → [788, 789] (44 + 44.5)
  EU 47 → [794] (no 47.5 available, cap at max)
  Women's EU 38 → [58]
WHY: Half sizes exist on Vinted but UI should show whole sizes only (cleaner). Auto-including half-size-up catches more listings (too-small shoes are bad, slightly-large is OK).
GOTCHA: sizeIds is now string[] not string throughout the pipeline — VintedSearchParams, searchVinted URL builder, all strategies. Don't revert to single ID.
